content_blocks.label: message_1_Nina
content_blocks.text: Chris, I need ur advice. My boss is being really hard on me lately. I don't know what to do...

content_blocks.label: message_2_Chris
content_blocks.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Have u tried talking to him about it?

content_blocks.label: message_3_Nina
content_blocks.text: I did, but he just brushed me off. It's like he's trying to intimidate me into working harder.

content_blocks.label: message_4_Chris
content_blocks.text: That's not okay. Maybe you should talk to HR or someone else in management. Stand up for yourself!
